recentItems.title: Kenya Kwanza leaders from Western attacks retired President Uhuru Kenyatta,
recentItems.description: Kenya Kwanza leaders from the Western region have criticized retired President Uhuru Kenyatta over allegations that he is engaging in active politics.

recentItems.title: Nairobi Flyways declaration: Stakeholders sign deal to protect migratory bird routes
recentItems.description: Governments, scientists, conservationists, NGOs and financial institutions have signed the Nairobi Flyways Declaration, committing to coordinated cross-border action to protect migratory bird routes.

recentItems.title: Kisii Governor Simba Arati defends the Green Army programme
recentItems.description: Kisii Governor Simba Arati has come out strongly in defence of the Green Army programme, dismissing criticism of the initiative and insisting that it has delivered tangible results in keeping Kisii town and its environs clean.

recentItems.title: Raila Odinga commemoration: ODM to hold series of events in honour of Raila Odinga
recentItems.description: The Orange Democratic Movement has lined up a series of activities to commemorate the life and legacy of its former leader and former Prime Minister, the late Raila Odinga. ODM Chairperson Gladys Wanga has called for party unity as the month-long commemoration begins.

recentItems.title: Cabinet Secretary Wycliffe Oparanya warns against harassment of Burundian traders
recentItems.description: Cooperatives and MSMEs Cabinet Secretary Wycliffe Oparanya has condemned the recent harassment of Burundian traders in Kenya, describing the incidents as deeply regrettable and calling for respect for the rights of all foreign nationals.

recentItems.title: El Niño rains warning: Busia residents urged to move from flood-prone areas
recentItems.description: Leaders in Busia County are urging residents across the Western region, particularly those in flood-prone areas, to take early precautions ahead of expected El Niño rains from next month.

recentItems.title: Linda Mwananchi Nairobi rally: Sifuna team warns Ruto allies against disrupting rally
recentItems.description: The Linda Mwananchi movement has warned government-aligned politicians against attempting to disrupt its Nairobi rally scheduled for tomorrow at Jacaranda Grounds.

recentItems.title: Lamu businessman Mohamed Mire abducted by armed men from his Witu home
recentItems.description: A cloud of fear and uncertainty hangs over Witu town following the brazen abduction of a prominent local businessman by men believed to be security officers. Mohamed Mire, 40, widely known as Mohamed Garisa, was taken from his home on Thursday night in a raid that has left his family traumatized and the local community demanding answers.

recentItems.title: Rigathi Gachagua condemns Omar over ‘dead voters’ remarks
recentItems.description: Democracy for the Citizens Party Leader Rigathi Gachagua has called on IEBC Chair Erastus Ethekon to respond to statements made by the ruling party Secretary General Hassan Omar that dead persons will vote in the 2027 General Election. Gachagua says taken together with an incident at the Kenyatta University where it was alleged that Central voters were being registered or transferred to vote in Wajir, public confidence in IEBC was wanning.

recentItems.title: Musalia Mudavadi aims Hassan Omar over ‘dead voters’ remarks
recentItems.description: Prime Cabinet Secretary Musalia Mudavadi has warned politicians against making reckless statements hinting at possible election interference, insisting that the upcoming elections shall be free and fair.
